review_method: Independent read-only reconciliation of 95 raw Vitest JSON reports, 95 raw logs, command receipts, current test inventory, source hashes and combined log. No test or application execution performed by the reviewer.

count_interpretation.pending: 297 assertions lack a verified completed result after worker SIGKILL. They may have been unstarted or interrupted; they are not evidence of 297 intentionally skipped tests.
count_interpretation.vitest_json_limitation: All 13 crashed-file JSON reports say success:true despite exit_code=1 and an unhandled worker error. numPendingTests sums to 2 while assertionResults contain 297 pending statuses. Use process exits, individual statuses and raw logs together.
count_interpretation.skip_observation: Only three static skipIf(win32) sites were found. Both containing test files completed with all assertions passed on this Linux run. No intentional skip was established.

limits: No measured source-code or branch-coverage percentage: this review checks exact test-file coverage and test outcomes.
SIGKILL is established by logs. Its cause (including possible memory pressure) is not established; there is no accessible cgroup/OOM evidence in this review.
No product-wide, production, deployment, database-service or real-provider qualification is implied.
Raw Vitest reports are intermediate files outside this repository. Their hashes, per-file reconciliations and aggregate assertion names/statuses are retained in the QA artifacts.

remaining_action.action: Run the unchanged KARTA gate on a separate CI runner and inspect its final process exit, all assertion statuses, exact inventory and unhandled errors before granting global PASS.
